title: maerua mucronata

This plant has been traditionally used in African and Asian cultures for its numerous health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and gastrointestinal disorders. The bioactive constituents of Maerua mucronata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
